title: domainee
description: Custom domains API for SaaS: connect, verify, and manage customer domains, SSL, and DNS
summary: Custom domains API for SaaS: connect, verify, and manage customer domains, SSL, and DNS
offersHint: Custom domains API for SaaS: connect, verify, and manage customer domains, SSL, and DNS · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.domainee.dev/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer token using a Domainee API key, e.g. `Bearer sk_live_...`. Without it the 16 free diagnostic tools still work and tools/list enumerates them; with it you also get the 11 workspace tools. Create one at https://domainee.dev/developers

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Optional. Bearer token using a Domainee API key, e.g. `Bearer sk_live_...`. Without it the 16 free diagnostic tools still work and tools/list enumerates them; with it you also get the 11 workspace tools. Create one at https://domainee.dev/developers

toolsPreview.name: tools_ssl_check
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Check the TLS certificate of any public hostname. Returns issuer, subject, validity dates, days until expiry, full chain, cipher, protocol, and SAN list. No Bearer required.

toolsPreview.name: tools_dns_record_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Look up DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain.

toolsPreview.name: tools_whois_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. WHOIS / RDAP lookup for a domain — registrar, status, created/updated/expires dates, nameservers.

toolsPreview.name: tools_cname_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Resolve a hostname's CNAME chain. Useful for debugging custom-domain CNAME setups.

toolsPreview.name: tools_http_header_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Fetch a URL and return its response headers + security grade based on common security headers.

toolsPreview.name: tools_dns_propagation_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Query the same hostname across ~10 public DNS resolvers worldwide and report which ones return the same answer. Useful right after a DNS change.

toolsPreview.name: tools_redirect_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Follow a URL's redirect chain and return every hop with status code, response time, final destination.

toolsPreview.name: tools_spf_record_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Look up and validate the SPF record for a domain. Counts void/total DNS lookups, flags syntax issues, validates against RFC 7208's 10-lookup limit.

toolsPreview.name: tools_domain_age_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Returns a domain's registration date, age in days + years, last-updated date, and expiration.

toolsPreview.name: tools_subdomain_finder
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Enumerate subdomains for a target domain via Certificate Transparency logs + DNS resolution.

toolsPreview.name: tools_reverse_ip_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Reverse-DNS (PTR) lookup for an IP address. Returns one or more hostnames if configured.

toolsPreview.name: tools_dmarc_record_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Look up the DMARC record at _dmarc.<domain>, parse policy/alignment/reporting tags, flag missing or too-permissive settings.

toolsPreview.name: tools_txt_record_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Fetch all TXT records on a domain, classifying each as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, verification token, or general.

toolsPreview.name: tools_website_status_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Check if a website is up or down. Returns HTTP status, response time, final URL after redirects, basic SSL info.

toolsPreview.name: tools_dkim_record_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Look up the DKIM record at <selector>._domainkey.<domain>, parse the public key, flag issues.

toolsPreview.name: tools_domain_availability_checker
toolsPreview.description: Free public API. Check availability of a name across one or more TLDs. Pass a `name` (no TLD) and an optional `tlds` array.
